title: Digital Twin-Driven Real2Sim2Real: Simulator-Conditioned Generation via Paired Driving-Scene Reconstruction
title_zh: 数字孪生驱动 Real2Sim2Real：基于配对的驾驶场景重建的模拟器条件生成

paragraphs.en: Camera-based 3D perception for autonomous driving relies heavily on large annotated datasets, and deploying such a system to a new target region typically requires data collection and annotation. Generative augmentation has been proposed to reduce this cost, but existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: label-conditioned methods consume the very annotations they aim to replace, while simulator-conditioned methods offer free annotations but lack visual grounding to specific real environments. This work investigates the extent to which a digital-twin-driven Real2Sim2Real pipeline (DT-R2S2R) can substitute for target-region real data. By reconstructing recorded driving clips inside a georeferenced digital twin (DT-R2S), we condition a diffusion model on geometrically aligned simulator renderings, establishing a digital twin-grounded Sim2Real model (DT-S2R). As a result, DT-S2R synthesizes photorealistic driving images given low-cost yet georeferenced simulator data across both reconstructed and novel simulator scenes within digital-twin coverage. The efficacy of generated data is verified on diverse 3D detectors. DETR3D, especially, reports 93.18% of mAP obtained by a target-region real-data oracle, without employing target images for detector training. Furthermore, simple co-training with existing out-of-target real data outperforms the oracle. Thus, DT-R2S2R can substantially reduce the cost of manual on-site data collection and annotation in digital twin-available districts, providing a practical foundation for scaling 3D perception. Comprehensive details are available at https://anonymouspaperdtr2s2r.netlify.app .
paragraphs.zh: 基于摄像头的自动驾驶三维感知技术严重依赖大型标注数据集，而将此类系统部署到新的目标区域时，通常需要收集数据并进行标注。 生成式数据增强已被提出用于降低这一成本，但现有方法面临一个根本性的权衡：以标签为条件的模型会消耗它们旨在替代的标注数据，而以模拟器为条件的模型虽然能提供免费标注，却缺乏与特定真实环境的视觉对应关系。 本研究探讨了由数字孪生驱动的“真实到模拟再到真实”流程（DT-R2S2R）能够在多大程度上替代目标区域的真实数据。 通过在地理配准的数字孪生中重建已记录的驾驶片段（DT-R2S），我们将扩散模型的条件设定在几何对齐的模拟器渲染图像上，从而建立一个以数字孪生为基准的“模拟到真实”模型（DT-S2R）。 因此，DT-S2R 能够在数字孪生覆盖范围内，基于低成本但经过地理配准的模拟器数据，合成出在重建场景和全新模拟场景中均具有照片级真实感的驾驶图像。 生成的数据有效性已在多种三维检测器上得到验证。 其中，DETR3D 报告称其 mAP 达到了目标区域真实数据参考模型（oracle）的 93.18%，且未使用目标区域的图像进行检测器训练。 此外，仅通过与现有的非目标区域真实数据进行简单的联合训练，其表现便优于该参考模型。 因此，DT-R2S2R 能够显著降低在具备数字孪生覆盖的区域中手动现场收集数据和标注的成本，为三维感知技术的规模化应用提供了实用基础。 完整细节请访问 https://anonymouspaperdtr2s2r.netlify.app。

paragraphs.en: Camera-based 3D perception for autonomous driving is trained on large annotated datasets [ 1 , 2 ] . Despite the considerable labeling cost, it is likely to recur whenever the system needs to be deployed to an unexplored region, given that road geometry, traffic composition, vehicle fleets, and roadside architecture can all differ. The bottleneck is thus not only the total volume of data but its regional specificity, implying that what is scarce is not driving data in general, but driving data from the region of interest.
paragraphs.zh: 基于摄像头的自动驾驶三维感知技术是在大型标注数据集上进行训练的 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 尽管标注成本相当高昂，但每当系统需要部署到未探索过的区域时，这种情况很可能再次出现，因为道路几何结构、交通组成、车队以及路边建筑都可能存在差异。 因此，瓶颈不仅在于数据的总体量，还在于其区域性特异性，这意味着稀缺的并非驾驶数据本身，而是来自目标区域的驾驶数据。

paragraphs.en: Generative data augmentation has been proposed to relieve this cost. One family conditions a diffusion model on the annotations of a real recording —BEV semantic map, 3D bounding boxes, and camera poses— and pairs each synthesized image with the annotation that produced it [ 3 , 4 ] . Because the generated frames inherit the geometry of an actual location, they transfer well to that location. Generating scenes beyond the annotated set, however, requires either further manual labeling or a separate tool to produce layouts.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究提出生成式数据增强方法，以减轻这一成本。 一种方法是让扩散模型根据真实记录中的标注——BEV语义地图、3D边界框和摄像头姿态——进行条件训练，并将每张合成图像与其生成时所用的标注配对 [ 3 , 4 ] 。 由于生成的帧继承了实际场景的几何结构，因此能够很好地迁移到该场景中。 然而，要生成超出已标注数据集的场景，则需要进一步的人工标注，或者使用专门的工具来生成布局。

paragraphs.en: Driving simulators are an attractive source for these annotations. The expensive labels that such generators require —semantic, depth maps, and 3D bounding boxes— are either native or easily producible outputs of the renderer and can be exported for any simulated scene at negligible marginal cost. This motivates closing the loop: reproducing a real driving scene in a simulator (Real2Sim), exporting the conditions from that reconstruction, and generating photorealistic frames from them (Sim2Real). Several recent Real2Sim2Real pipelines [ 5 , 6 ] follow this pattern.
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶模拟器是获取这些标注的一个极具吸引力的来源。 这类生成器所需的昂贵标签——语义信息、深度图和三维边界框——要么是渲染器本身就能直接输出的结果，要么也能轻松生成，并且可以以几乎忽略不计的边际成本为任何模拟场景导出。 这促使我们实现闭环：在模拟器中重现真实的驾驶场景（Real2Sim），从该重建场景中导出环境条件，并基于这些条件生成照片级的逼真帧（Sim2Real）。 近期提出的几种 Real2Sim2Real 流程 [5, 6] 都遵循了这一模式。

sents.en: Several recent Real2Sim2Real pipelines [ 5 , 6 ] follow this pattern.
sents.zh: 近期提出的几种 Real2Sim2Real 流程 [5, 6] 都遵循了这一模式。

paragraphs.en: However, in these systems, the reconstruction usually covers only the placement of dynamic objects and a coarse road layout. The static surroundings of the location, such as building geometries and roadside structures, have no counterpart in the simulated scene and are left for the Sim2Real generator to synthesize without grounding. To address this, we construct D igital- T win-driven R eal 2S im 2R eal ( DT-R2S2R ) pipeline, where the road network, buildings, terrain, and vehicle assets are modeled based on the real world rather than arbitrarily synthesized [ 7 , 8 ] . Our pipeline consists of two modules, DT-R2S and DT-S2R. First, DT-R2S locates a real driving clip inside the digital twin by matching its GNSS trace against twin maps, replaces each annotated vehicle with the library asset closest in dimension and appearance, and estimates the sensor pose aligning the reconstructed scene with the original recording. Through the scene rendering, we obtain synthetic RGB images geometrically paired with real counterparts and their low-cost annotations from the simulator. DT-S2R then takes them as input to condition a diffusion backbone, yielding photorealistic and geospatially grounded images. Importantly, producing additional virtual driving clips within the simulator and passing them to trained DT-S2R enables the large-scale synthesis of high-fidelity and georeferenced data for the specific target regions at marginal cost, as shown in Fig. 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在这些系统中，重建通常仅涵盖动态物体的位置以及粗略的道路布局。 该地点的静态环境，例如建筑几何形状和路边结构，在模拟场景中没有对应物，因此需要由 Sim2Real 生成器在没有真实参照的情况下进行合成。 为了解决这个问题，我们构建了数字孪生驱动的真实到虚拟（DT-R2S2R）流程，其中道路网络、建筑、地形和车辆资产均基于现实世界建模，而非随意合成 [7, 8]。 我们的流程由两个模块组成：DT-R2S 和 DT-S2R。 首先，DT-R2S 通过将真实驾驶片段的全局导航卫星系统（GNSS）轨迹与孪生地图进行匹配，在数字孪生中定位该片段；随后将每个标注的车辆替换为尺寸和外观最接近的库中资产，并通过调整重建场景以对齐原始记录来估算传感器姿态。 通过场景渲染，我们获得了与真实图像在几何上配对的合成 RGB 图像，以及来自模拟器的低成本标注信息。 接着，DT-S2R 将这些图像作为输入，用于条件化扩散模型主干网络，从而生成具有照片级真实感且具备地理空间参照的图像。 重要的是，通过在模拟器中生成额外的虚拟驾驶片段并将其输入训练好的 DT-S2R，可以以极低的成本大规模合成针对特定目标区域的高保真、带地理参照的数据，如图 1 所示。

paragraphs.en: We construct DT-R2S2R that couples geometrically paired driving-scene reconstruction (DT-R2S) with a spatially-consistent image translation (DT-S2R).
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 DT-R2S2R，它将几何配对的驾驶场景重建（DT-R2S）与空间一致的图片转换（DT-S2R）相结合。

paragraphs.en: We comprehensively validate our pipeline not only as a high-fidelity image generator but also as a labeled-data engine for 3D detection training across diverse settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们全面验证了我们的流程，不仅将其用作高保真图像生成器，还将其用作跨多种场景的 3D 检测训练的标注数据引擎。

paragraphs.en: Game engines and driving simulators make it affordable to produce large, labeled driving datasets, but in many cases, these datasets lack real-world counterparts. Several datasets have addressed this by introducing direct references to real datasets to narrow the gap. For example, nuCarla [ 9 ] mirrors the sensor layout and data format of nuScenes [ 1 ] . Closer correspondence has been obtained by reconstructing the recordings. DIVA-Sim [ 5 ] rebuilds nuScenes clips in a simulator, recovering the road network and replaying the logged object trajectories. VKITTI [ 10 ] goes further for KITTI [ 2 ] , also reproducing background structures such as buildings and trees. Following this line, we perform Real2Sim inside a digital twin built from the HD map of the target region, where the road network, buildings, and terrain are already available at high fidelity, so that any clip recorded within the covered area can be paired with a geometrically aligned rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏引擎和驾驶模拟器使得生成大规模、带标签的驾驶数据集成本降低，但在许多情况下，这些数据集缺乏现实世界中的对应数据。 一些数据集通过引入对真实数据集的直接引用来缩小这一差距。 例如，nuCarla [ 9 ] 复刻了 nuScenes [ 1 ] 的传感器布局和数据结构。 通过对记录数据进行重建，可以实现更紧密的对应关系。 DIVA-Sim [ 5 ] 在模拟器中重建 nuScenes 片段，恢复道路网络并重播记录下来的物体轨迹。 VKITTI [ 10 ] 针对 KITTI [ 2 ] 更进一步，还重现了建筑物和树木等背景结构。 遵循这一思路，我们在基于目标区域高清地图构建的数字孪生环境中执行 Real2Sim，其中道路网络、建筑物和地形均已以高保真度存在，因此任何在覆盖区域内录制的片段都可以与几何对齐的渲染结果相匹配。

paragraphs.en: The transformation of a rendered synthetic image into a realistic one has traditionally been posed as an unpaired image-to-image translation, as paired real-synthetic image sets are often not available. The characteristic limitation of those approaches is semantic flipping [ 11 ] . To overcome this limitation, FDA [ 12 ] swaps the low-frequency amplitude of source and target images, which does not require training and retains the source contents. An adversarial learning-based method VSAIT [ 11 ] , on the other hand, addresses this by learning the mapping in a high-dimensional vector space, where source-related information, such as texture and color, is unbound and target-related information is bound in its place. SODA-CAM [ 13 ] adapts the formulation to multimodal driving data.
paragraphs.zh: 将渲染的合成图像转换为真实图像的问题，传统上被表述为一种无配对的图像到图像翻译任务，因为成对的真实-合成图像数据集通常并不可用。 这类方法的一个典型局限性是语义翻转 [ 11 ] 。 为了克服这一局限性，FDA [ 12 ] 交换了源图像和目标图像的低频振幅，这种方法无需训练且能保留源图像的内容。 另一方面，基于对抗性学习的 VSAIT [ 11 ] 方法则通过在更高维的向量空间中学习映射来解决这一问题：在该空间中，与源图像相关的信息（如纹理和颜色）不再受约束，而目标图像相关的信息则取而代之地受到约束。 SODA-CAM [ 13 ] 将这一公式框架适配到了多模态驾驶数据中。

paragraphs.en: Another common choice for the same task is latent diffusion models (LDMs), such as SDXL [ 14 ] , with auxiliary networks which supply conditions. For instance, ControlNet [ 15 ] copies the down and middle blocks of the backbone, processes the given condition, and injects their output back to the backbone. T2I-Adapter [ 16 ] replaces the copy with a small feature extractor. SDEdit [ 17 ] , on the other hand, uses the noise-added condition as a starting point for the denoising process. Extending this direction, conditional diffusion models are also widely used to generate driving data directly from annotations. MagicDrive [ 3 ] , SimGen [ 5 ] , and InstaDrive [ 4 ] are recent examples where labels of a real recording are consumed as conditions so that the generated frames are paired with those.

paragraphs.en: Across the mentioned methods, the output is limited by how much of the real scene the condition describes: a projected box or a semantic map states where an object is, not what it or its surroundings look like. Hence, a generator can only imagine the appearance of the surrounding structure, which often induces semantic flipping. We therefore use a rendering from the digital twin as a strong anchor for a paired Sim2Real translation, facilitating the preservation of critical static structures.
paragraphs.zh: 在上述方法中，输出结果受限于条件对真实场景的描述程度：一个投影的盒子或语义地图只能说明物体的位置，而无法体现物体本身或其周围环境的具体外观。 因此，生成器只能构想周围结构的外观，而这常常会导致语义翻转。 因此，我们使用数字孪生的渲染结果作为配对 Sim2Real 转换的强约束，从而有助于保留关键的静态结构。

paragraphs.en: To generate scene-level geometrically paired counterparts, we embed real-world driving clips (AI-Hub) of South Korea into MORAI SIM [ 8 ] , a digital twin simulator where HD map-based road network and buildings for two urban districts, Sangam and Pangyo of the same country, together with a library of vehicle assets are available. As shown in Fig. 2 , the following three steps are conducted: (1) real-to-simulator coordinate conversion, (2) real-vehicle-to-virtual-asset mapping, and (3) sensor pose estimation that closely aligns both the geometry and appearance of real images and rendered counterparts.
paragraphs.zh: 为了生成场景级别的几何配对对应物，我们将韩国真实世界的驾驶片段（AI-Hub）嵌入到 MORAI SIM [ 8 ] 中。这是一个数字孪生模拟器，其中包含基于高清地图的道路网络和该国两个城区——上岩和盆谷的建筑，同时还提供了一组车辆资产库。 如图 2 所示，执行以下三个步骤：（1）从真实世界到模拟器的坐标转换，（2）将真实车辆映射为虚拟资产，以及（3）传感器姿态估计，该步骤使真实图像与渲染出的对应物在几何形状和外观上高度一致。

paragraphs.en: We locate each recorded clip in the simulator by converting the ego vehicle’s GNSS trace into the map frame via UTM projection. Since traces are acquired with high-accuracy RTK-DGPS, the converted trajectories align with the simulation environment without additional post-processing of the poses. As the digital twin covers only a finite area, we discard any clip that contains even a single out-of-bounds frame. To check the coverage of a clip, we extract lane-boundary nodes from the HD map and define each district’s spatial extent as a convex hull. A clip is retained only if all of its frames fall within the hull.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 UTM 投影将自动驾驶车辆的 GNSS 轨迹转换到地图坐标系中，从而在模拟器中定位每个已录制的片段。 由于这些轨迹是使用高精度 RTK-DGPS 获取的，因此转换后的轨迹无需对姿态进行额外后处理即可与模拟环境对齐。 由于数字孪生仅覆盖有限区域，任何包含哪怕一个超出边界的帧的片段都将被丢弃。 为了检查某个片段的覆盖范围，我们从高清地图中提取车道边界节点，并将每个区域的空间范围定义为凸包。 只有当片段中的所有帧都位于该凸包内部时，才会保留该片段。

paragraphs.en: After a clip is selected, we need to reproduce the dynamic objects (car, bus, and truck) of the scene inside the simulator. The dynamic state of each annotated object transfers directly from the recording, but two questions remain: which simulator asset substitutes for the object, and how it is positioned. First, we match the two by dimension and appearance. For box dimensions, we take the per-axis maximum over the object’s tracked horizon, because a cuboid labeled from a single LiDAR sweep tends to underestimate a vehicle’s true extent due to occlusion and missing returns. We rank the assets against the aggregated size by a weighted cost over length, width, and height. Each axis is weighted by its normalized coefficient of variation (length: 0.35, width: 0.24, height: 0.41), prioritizing more discriminative dimensions. The top-5 candidates are then re-ranked by appearance: SAM [ 18 ] -segmented crop of the object and each candidate asset are encoded into DINOv3 [ 19 ] features, and the candidate with the highest cosine similarity is kept. Second, we place assets by their near-corner positions. Among the four BEV corners, the one nearest to the LiDAR is the only physical measurement: annotations are drawn by fitting L- or I-shaped returns anchored on that corner, even if they are parameterized by their centroids afterward. We thus re-reference each object to its near corner before instantiating it in the simulator.
paragraphs.zh: 选择剪辑片段后，我们需要在模拟器中重现场景中的动态物体（汽车、公交车和卡车）。 每个已标注物体的动态状态会直接从记录中转移，但仍有两个问题需要解决：哪个模拟器资产可以替代该物体，以及它应如何定位。 首先，我们根据尺寸和外观将两者进行匹配。 对于盒体尺寸，我们取物体在整个跟踪时间范围内各轴线的最大值，因为仅通过一次激光雷达扫描标注的长方体往往会因遮挡和点云缺失而低估车辆的真实范围。 我们通过按长度、宽度和高度计算加权成本，将资产与聚合尺寸进行排名比较。 每条轴线都根据其归一化变异系数进行加权（长度：0.35，宽度：0.24，高度：0.41），从而优先选择更具区分度的维度。 随后，根据外观对前 5 个候选项重新排序：将物体的 SAM [ 18 ] 分割裁剪区域与每个候选资产编码为 DINOv3 [ 19 ] 特征，并保留余弦相似度最高的候选项。 其次，我们根据资产的近角位置进行放置。 在四个 BEV 角点中，最靠近激光雷达的角点是唯一有物理测量的点：标注是通过拟合以该角点为锚点的 L 形或 I 形点云生成的，即使后续会用其质心进行参数化。 因此，在模拟器中实例化每个物体之前，我们会先将其重新参考到其近角位置。

paragraphs.en: AI-Hub provides a georeferenced ego trajectory and 3D bounding boxes with respect to LiDAR frame, together with the LiDAR-to-GNSS extrinsics. However, it does not specify where the sensors are located within the vehicle body, so the sensor extrinsics with respect to the vehicle must be recovered for simulation. To resolve this, our strategy is to anchor the simulator ego’s reference frame to the GNSS trajectory and deduce the remaining internal sensor placements via LiDAR data matching.
paragraphs.zh: AI-Hub 提供了一个地理配准的自我轨迹和相对于激光雷达帧的 3D 边界框，同时还提供了激光雷达到全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）的外参。 然而，它并未说明传感器在车体内的具体位置，因此必须恢复传感器相对于车辆的外参才能进行模拟。 为了解决这个问题，我们的策略是将模拟器自我的参考系锚定到 GNSS 轨迹上，并通过激光雷达数据匹配来推断其余内部传感器的位置。

paragraphs.en: We initialize the simulator ego’s reference pose with the GNSS, transferring the horizontal placement (i.e., easting and northing in UTM) from the real data. Since the simulator grounds the vehicle to the terrain, GNSS height and tilt become redundant, leaving the LiDAR’s relative height and tilt unknown. paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 GNSS 初始化模拟器的本体参考姿态，将水平位置（即 UTM 坐标系中的东向和北向坐标）从真实数据中转移过来。 由于模拟器将车辆固定在地形上，GNSS 提供的高度和倾斜信息变得多余，而 LiDAR 的相对高度和倾斜则仍然未知。 在模拟器本体通过 GNSS 锚定的情况下，我们通过最小化 LiDAR 坐标系中真实边界框与模拟边界框之间的几何差异，来确定缺失的 LiDAR 到本体的变换矩阵（ T ^ L ​ i ​ D ​ A ​ R E ​ g ​ o \hat{T}_{LiDAR}^{Ego} ）：

sents.en: We initialize the simulator ego’s reference pose with the GNSS, transferring the horizontal placement (i.e., easting and northing in UTM) from the real data.
sents.zh: 我们使用 GNSS 初始化模拟器的本体参考姿态，将水平位置（即 UTM 坐标系中的东向和北向坐标）从真实数据中转移过来。

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction in a digital twin paired with the real-world recording already provides a wealth of information for Sim2Real generator to leverage: a robust anchor for the placement of dynamic objects and a reference for static structures that every rendered view coherently shares. In this sense, we hypothesize that minimal modifications to the generative network could be sufficient. Consequently, the backbone is frozen throughout, and our modifications are focused on how the conditions are injected.
paragraphs.zh: 数字孪生中的重建与真实世界记录相结合，已经为 Sim2Real 生成器提供了丰富的可用信息：动态物体定位的可靠锚点，以及所有渲染视图都能保持一致性的静态结构参考。 从这个意义上说，我们假设对生成网络进行最小程度的修改就足以实现目标。 因此，整个主干网络保持冻结状态，我们的修改主要集中在条件信息的注入方式上。

paragraphs.en: As summarized in Table I , we use one real and two synthetic datasets to demonstrate our approach. paragraphs.en: The quality of generated images is measured with four complementary quantities. PSNR and SSIM quantify pixel-level and structural agreement with the paired real frame. LPIPS measures distance to real image at deep-feature level. Lastly, FID compares the real and generated image sets at the distribution level. For downstream perception tasks, mAP and NDS [ 1 ] across car, bus, and truck classes are measured for 3D detection. Scores are evaluated on a D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{InTwin} validation set unless otherwise mentioned.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的图像质量通过四个互补的指标进行衡量。 PSNR 和 SSIM 分别量化了像素级以及与配对真实帧在结构上的一致性。 LPIPS 在深层特征层面衡量与真实图像的距离。 最后，FID 在分布层面比较真实图像集和生成图像集。 对于下游感知任务，针对汽车、公交车和卡车类别，会测量 3D 检测的 mAP 和 NDS [ 1 ]。 除非另有说明，否则得分均在 D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ lD^{Real}_{InTwin} 验证集上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Table II isolates each stage of Section III-A2 and III-A3 on the raw reconstruction. 2D IoU is the image-space IoU between real and simulated cuboids, each projected onto the camera in which the simulated box is largest. 3D Corner Error is the mean distance over all corners of real and asset 3D boxes.
paragraphs.zh: 表 II 分别分析了原始重建中第 III-A2 节和第 III-A3 节的各个阶段。2D IoU 是真实长方体与模拟长方体在图像空间中的 IoU，其中每个长方体都投影到模拟盒子最大的那个相机中。3D 角点误差则是真实盒子与资产 3D 盒子所有角点之间距离的平均值。

paragraphs.en: The baseline—per-axis-max dimension aggregation with near-corner placement and the box-corner pose estimate—reaches 57.5 IoU and 0.581 m corner error. Appearance re-ranking trades a marginal amount of geometric fit for visual similarity (56.7, 0.632 m). This could be explained as the visually closest asset need not be the dimensionally closest one among candidates with near-tied dimensions, and corner error conflates that mismatch with pose error. The two remaining stages recover and surpass the baseline on all metrics. Ground-plane refinement raises IoU to 59.4. Clustering per-clip estimates into one transform per calibration group then gives the best scores throughout (60.4, 0.565 m), indicating the importance of a proper strategy to address per-clip pose noise. Nevertheless, precision remains bounded by the finite asset catalog, underscoring the need for automated asset reconstruction from sensor data as a key enabler of scaling.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法——按轴取最大维度的聚合方式，结合近角落放置和箱角姿态估计——实现了 57.5 的 IoU 和 0.581 米的角点误差。 外观重排序以视觉相似性为代价，略微牺牲了部分几何拟合度（56.7，0.632 米）。 这可以解释为：在维度相近的候选对象中，视觉上最接近的对象未必是尺寸上最接近的一个，而角点误差将这种不匹配与姿态误差混为一谈。 其余两个阶段在所有指标上都恢复并超越了基线方法的表现。 地面平面优化将 IoU 提升至 59.4。 随后，将每个剪辑中的估计值聚类为每个校准组的一个变换，获得了全程的最佳分数（60.4，0.565 米），这表明采用适当的策略来处理每个剪辑中的姿态噪声至关重要。 然而，其精度仍受限于有限的资产目录，这凸显了从传感器数据中自动重建资产作为扩展能力关键手段的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Despite the sophisticated design for geometrically paired reconstruction, there exists a non-negligible visual domain gap to the real counterparts, coming from the limitation of the rendering pipeline. To address this, we additionally employ Sim2Real translation and evaluate it across three families — signal-processing, GAN, and diffusion. As presented in Table III , diffusion-based methods generally produce more realistic results than other methods. Based on the observation, we develop our DT-S2R (Stage1) upon the frozen diffusion backbone with ControlNet. For comparison, we also vary the injection mechanism of rendered RGB across two configurations: SDEdit and T2I-Adapter.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管采用了复杂的几何配对重建设计，但与真实对应物之间仍存在不可忽略的视觉域差异，这源于渲染流程的局限性。 为解决这一问题，我们进一步采用了 Sim2Real 转换方法，并在信号处理、GAN 和扩散模型这三类方法中对其进行了评估。 如表 III 所示，基于扩散模型的方法通常能生成比其他方法更逼真的结果。 基于这一观察结果，我们在冻结的扩散模型主干架构上结合 ControlNet，开发出了我们的 DT-S2R（阶段 1）。 为了进行比较，我们还对渲染出的 RGB 图像的注入机制进行了两种配置的调整：SDEdit 和 T2I-Adapter。

paragraphs.en: It is worth noting that the behavior of SDEdit is one end of a trade-off. Because it alters the conditioning RGB conservatively, the rendered structure remains after translation, leading to a lower chance of semantic flipping. This characteristic would make SDEdit more suitable as a training data engine for dense perception tasks such as segmentation, where pixel-level alignment between the generated labels and translated images is essential.
paragraphs.zh: 值得注意的是，SDEdit 的行为是某种权衡的一端。 由于它以保守的方式修改条件 RGB，渲染出的结构在翻译后仍然存在，从而降低了语义翻转的可能性。 这一特性使 SDEdit 更适合作为密集感知任务（如分割）的训练数据引擎，因为这类任务要求生成的标签与翻译后的图像在像素级别上严格对齐。

paragraphs.en: Image-quality metrics state how similar two images look, not whether a perception model reads them the same way. We therefore comprehensively run one mono-view and two multiview detectors trained on AI-Hub ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{InTwin} ) over DT-R2S ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l ​ 2 ​ S ​ i ​ m D^{Real2Sim}_{InTwin} ) and DT-S2R ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} ) outputs, respectively. We then score their predictions against the original real ground truth in Table IV . Note that the scores show the disagreement accumulating two error sources, the geometry misalignment from the scene-recovery step and appearance gap from the translation step.
paragraphs.zh: 图像质量指标衡量的是两张图像在外观上的相似程度，而非感知模型是否以相同方式解读它们。 因此，我们分别对 DT-R2S（D^{Real}_{InTwin}）、DT-S2R（D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin}）和 DT-R2S-2-Sim（D^{Real2Sim}_{InTwin}）的输出，全面运行了基于 AI-Hub 训练的单个视角检测器和两个多视角检测器。 接着，我们在表 IV 中根据原始真实地面真值对它们的预测结果进行评分。 请注意，这些分数反映了两种误差来源的累积差异：场景恢复步骤中的几何对齐偏差以及转换步骤中的外观差异。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we evaluate the feasibility of deploying a 3D detection system to the target region without directly utilizing any target-region real images for detector training. To this end, we investigate the effect of combining two synthetic datasets: reconstructed clips ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} ) and ADC25 ( D A ​ D ​ C ​ 25 S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{ADC25} ), a purely simulator-generated dataset using the digital twin and trained DT-S2R.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们评估在不直接使用任何目标区域的真实图像进行检测器训练的前提下，将三维检测系统部署到目标区域的可行性。 为此，我们研究了结合两个合成数据集的效果：重建片段（ D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} ）和 ADC25（ D A ​ D ​ C ​ 25 S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{ADC25} ），后者是一个完全由数字孪生和训练好的 DT-S2R 在模拟器中生成的数据集。

sents.en: In this section, we evaluate the feasibility of deploying a 3D detection system to the target region without directly utilizing any target-region real images for detector training.

sents.en: To this end, we investigate the effect of combining two synthetic datasets: reconstructed clips ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} ) and ADC25 ( D A ​ D ​ C ​ 25 S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{ADC25} ), a purely simulator-generated dataset using the digital twin and trained DT-S2R.
sents.zh: 为此，我们研究了结合两个合成数据集的效果：重建片段（ D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} ）和 ADC25（ D A ​ D ​ C ​ 25 S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{ADC25} ），后者是一个完全由数字孪生和训练好的 DT-S2R 在模拟器中生成的数据集。

paragraphs.en: Table VII summarizes the efficacy of our generated data. Training on D A ​ D ​ C ​ 25 S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{ADC25} alone achieves 29.39 and 34.41 mAP on DETR3D and PETR, which are close to 61% of oracle performance. Additionally, when combined with D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} , mAP of DETR3D increases further to 45.50, 93.18% of oracle score, and the same trend can be observed for PETR, reporting 88.84% of oracle performance. Importantly, when compared against the practical real-world baseline trained on out-of-target region data ( D O ​ f ​ f ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{OffTwin} ), it outperforms the baseline by +5.52 mAP on DETR3D and achieves a comparable score on PETR. Although the non-negligible performance gaps of 3.33 mAP for DETR3D and 6.16 mAP for PETR to the oracle scores still remain, these results show that our digital twin-grounded synthetic data can effectively substitute for real-world data collected and labeled for the target region.
paragraphs.zh: 表 VII 总结了我们所生成数据的有效性。 仅使用 D A ​ D ​ C ​ 25 S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{ADC25} 进行训练，在 DETR3D 和 PETR 上分别取得了 29.39 和 34.41 mAP，接近 oracle 性能的 61%。 此外，当与 D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} 结合使用时，DETR3D 的 mAP 进一步提升至 45.50，达到 oracle 分数的 93.18%；PETR 也呈现出相同趋势，达到了 oracle 性能的 88.84%。 重要的是，与在目标区域之外数据（ D O ​ f ​ f ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{OffTwin} ）上训练的实际现实世界基线模型相比，该模型在 DETR3D 上的 mAP 高出 +5.52，并在 PETR 上取得了相当接近的分数。 尽管与 oracle 分数相比，DETR3D 和 PETR 仍存在 3.33 mAP 和 6.16 mAP 的非微不足道的性能差距，但这些结果表明，我们基于数字孪生的合成数据能够有效地替代为目标区域采集和标注的现实世界数据。

paragraphs.en: Beyond normal scene reproduction, our framework can offer a mechanism to generate safety-critical data grounded in geo-referenced real-world environments. Fig. 6 demonstrates our exploratory step toward this direction. By perturbing dynamic actors within a spatially anchored digital twin, we can synthesize hazardous edge cases directly from normal driving logs.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we investigated the value of georeferenced digital twins as a scalable, annotation-free training data source for camera-based 3D perception in a novel deployment scenario. By conditioning a diffusion model on rendered views, depth, and semantics from digital twin reconstructions, our DT-R2S2R framework synthesizes photorealistic driving data across both reconstructed scenes and novel simulator scenarios. Our experimental findings demonstrate that 3D detectors trained solely on this synthetic data recover a substantial portion of full performance of a target-region real-data oracle, and further outperform that oracle when co-trained with existing out-of-region real datasets. Where digital twin infrastructure is accessible, DT-R2S2R provides a practical and cost-effective pathway to scale 3D perception systems, which mitigates the expense of manual on-site data collection and annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了地理参考数字孪生作为一种可扩展且无需标注的训练数据源，在一种新型部署场景下用于基于摄像头的三维感知时的价值。 通过将扩散模型以数字孪生重建中的渲染视图、深度和语义为条件，我们的 DT-R2S2R 框架能够在重建场景和新的模拟场景中合成出逼真的驾驶数据。 我们的实验结果表明，仅使用这些合成数据进行训练的三维检测器能够恢复目标区域真实数据模型的大部分性能，并且在与现有的区域外真实数据集联合训练时，其表现甚至优于该真实数据模型。 在数字孪生基础设施可用的情况下，DT-R2S2R 提供了一条实用且经济高效的路径来扩展三维感知系统，从而减少了现场手动数据收集和标注的成本。
